goal: Fuzz the HTTP state machine across partial read cycles to catch bugs in resumable parsing
Allow the fuzzer to reach maximum header size limits to verify length boundary enforcement
agreement: Strong support with no open objections
Verified by fuzzing with ASan and checking that mutated paths trip assertions (jeanpablojp)
Supports expanding coverage of resumable parsing across input slices (hodlinator)
Approved after container testing and extended fuzzing with nonblocking questions left (pinheadmz)

categories.name: tests
why: P3 because it expands fuzz harness coverage to parser edge cases across chunked I/O boundaries
It touches only the HTTP fuzz target rather than high-risk consensus or peer-to-peer code paths
